choices: A note that says only “harvest complete.”
Source and output identity, destination, outgoing and receiving quantity, hold/deviation status, actions taken, and required next follow-up.
A statement that the lot moved successfully with no other details.
Only the final received weight because that is the most important outcome.
rationale: A reconstructable handoff should let the receiving shift understand what material moved, where it went, how quantities compared, whether any hold or deviation remains, what actions were already taken, and what must happen next. Generic completion language cannot support that continuity.
